scenarios.description: Nested class containers and their contents are declared with correct kinds and are reachable through namespace-prefix filtering.
provenance_assertions: container/nested declarations: tree_sitter provenance, syntax precision
nested symbol reachable through namespace_prefix filtering

scenarios.description: Single-type imports and static member imports are recorded as import facts with syntax provenance; a static-imported member name resolves bare calls.
provenance_assertions: import/alias facts: tree_sitter provenance, syntax precision

scenarios.description: Production and test sources are classified by ecosystem path conventions in repo_map.
provenance_assertions: file inventory: git provenance; roles from ecosystem path conventions

scenarios.description: Duplicate symbol names yield multiple candidates and a typed ambiguity error instead of a silent resolution.
provenance_assertions: duplicate names: every candidate listed; ambiguity is a typed error, never guessed

scenarios.description: Definitions, references, and callers are answered at syntax precision (heuristic call edges) without a precise provider.
provenance_assertions: call edges: tree_sitter provenance, heuristic precision, no precise provider

scenarios.description: Test methods are identified per ecosystem conventions (xUnit [Fact]) and carry the test source role.
provenance_assertions: test hint: tree_sitter provenance, syntax precision, test source role

scenarios.description: Text search finds a needle in exactly one file and labels the hit textual, never syntax or precise.
provenance_assertions: text hits: text_search provenance, textual precision

scenarios.description: A query exceeding its limit reports truncation explicitly with section and cause.
provenance_assertions: limit exceedance: truncated flag plus section/cause detail

scenarios.description: A temporary syntax error publishes actionable diagnostics while intact declarations remain queryable, and fixing the file clears diagnostics.
provenance_assertions: broken file: actionable diagnostics with file attribution; intact declarations stay queryable
repair: diagnostics cleared on a newer published revision

scenarios.description: Create, modify, atomic-save (temp write plus rename), rename, and delete are each visible to fresh queries without sleeps.
provenance_assertions: create/modify/atomic-save/rename/delete: each step visible to the next fresh query

scenarios.description: diff_context attributes changed files correctly for worktree and base-ref scopes.
provenance_assertions: changed-file facts: git provenance; worktree and base-ref scopes attribute disjoint file sets

scenarios.description: Without a precise provider, callers/context still answer with syntax provenance and report the provider as not configured.
provenance_assertions: provider absent: queries answer with syntax provenance, state not_configured, no failure

scenarios.description: A failing precise provider degrades to syntax facts with explicit fallback, and a recovered provider contributes precise facts again.
provenance_assertions: provider crash: explicit fallback, syntax facts retained, precision never upgraded silently
provider recovery: precise facts merge with precise precision and provider provenance

scenarios.description: A symbol with 56 call sites (55 fan-in callers plus one static-import call) returns complete bounded callers and reports truncation at the default limit.
provenance_assertions: 56 call sites: complete heuristic callers at an explicit limit; default limit truncates explicitly
